reader1.note: Tree-sitter query captures are stored as one symbols row per symbol (kind, name, start_line, end_line, file_id).

reader2.note: Tree-sitter query captures stored as SymbolRecord rows with kind, name, start_line, end_line and file.

reader1.note: Per-language tree-sitter query strings (Python, C, C++, JS, TS, Rust, C#, Java, Go, PHP, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Lua, ...) registered in one table via get_language.

reader2.note: LANGUAGES registers ~19 languages each with its own grammar and query, dispatched via detect_language.

reader1.note: symbols rows carry signature, return_type, parameters and doc_comment filled by the indexer (parameters/return_type are mostly unset by the indexer).

reader2.note: signature, return_type, parameters and doc_comment stored per symbol, filled by the indexer.

reader1.searched: grep in src/srclight/*.py and extractors/: visibility, is_async, is_static in indexer.py, languages.py, db.py
reader1.note: symbols table and SymbolRecord have visibility/is_async/is_static columns used by get_dead_symbols, but the indexer builds SymbolRecord without ever setting them.

reader2.searched: grep -rn 'visibility|is_async|is_static' in src/srclight/*.py; SymbolRecord( constructors in indexer.py lines 3350,3469,3496
reader2.note: Columns visibility/is_async/is_static exist and dead-code reads visibility, but no SymbolRecord construction ever sets them.

reader1.note: Test functions/files are recognised by name and path patterns (test_X, %test%/%spec% paths) at query time, but no tag is stored on symbols.

reader2.note: Test functions/files recognised by path (test/spec) and name patterns at query time; dead-code excludes test code; no stored tag.

reader1.note: symbol_edges stores calls edges with confidence; get_callers/get_callees query both directions.

reader2.note: symbol_edges rows of type calls plus get_callers/get_callees and MCP tools.

reader1.note: Imports are extracted and resolved to indexed symbols per file on demand (find_imports), but no import edges are stored in symbol_edges (only calls and inherits).

reader2.note: Imports are extracted by regex and resolved to indexed symbols at query time; no stored file-to-file import edges table.

reader1.note: inherits edges from base-class specifiers are stored and read by get_type_hierarchy/get_implementors.

reader2.note: 'inherits' edges stored for class/struct bases and read by get_type_hierarchy/get_implementors.

reader1.note: EdgeScanner picks targets by same_file/unique_file/import/same_dir/name_only rungs, recorded in symbol_edges.resolution, using file imports and arity/type narrowing.

reader2.note: Edge scanner resolves references using same_file, unique_file, import and same_dir evidence with confidence and per-edge resolution field.

reader1.note: Louvain (networkx) over call edges, stored in communities/symbol_communities with keyword labels; get_communities tool.

reader2.note: Louvain (networkx) over call edges, stored with labels and keywords.

reader1.note: Edges link a symbol to class/struct/enum/interface symbols named in its body, but they are all labelled calls; no references/uses-type/reads-writes edge kinds.

reader2.note: Edges also target class/struct/enum/interface symbols by name reference, but edge_type is only calls (and inherits); no fields/constants or separate references kind.

reader1.note: Three FTS5 indexes (names, trigram content, porter docs) queried by search_symbols/CLI search.

reader2.note: Three FTS5 indexes (names, trigram content, docs) queried by search_symbols with tiered ranking.

reader1.note: symbol_embeddings table with vector search (vector_math/vector_cache) behind semantic_search and RRF hybrid_search.

reader2.note: Per-symbol embeddings (Ollama/other) stored in symbol_embeddings with cosine nearest-neighbour search; optional if no model configured.

reader1.note: LIKE substring/prefix fallback with exact->prefix->length ordering, NOCASE, plus code-aware name_tokens FTS; no edit distance.

reader2.note: Ladder of exact, case-folded, token-folded, prefix and substring name matches plus trigram FTS.

reader1.note: find_pattern takes a regex and returns matching symbols with file and line ranges.

reader2.note: find_pattern applies a regex over symbol source and returns matching lines and locations.

reader1.note: srclight serve (stdio or sse) starts a FastMCP server with ~43 @mcp.tool functions.

reader2.note: `srclight serve` runs a FastMCP server (stdio or SSE) exposing ~45 tools.

reader1.note: click group with index, search, symbols, status, serve, tool, workspace, hook and config subcommands.

reader2.note: click group with index, search, symbols, status, serve, tool, workspace and hook subcommands.

reader1.note: serve --web mounts a Starlette dashboard and /api/* REST routes (search, codebase_map, index_status) on a port.

reader2.note: `serve --web` mounts a Starlette dashboard and /api/* routes (search, codebase_map, stats).

reader1.note: hook install writes git reindex hooks, hook install-agent registers a coding-agent hook; config claude-code/cursor emit MCP client config.

reader2.note: `srclight hook install` writes git hooks and a Claude Code PreToolUse hook (agent-redirect) into settings.

reader1.note: Named workspaces of several repos with per-project selection via the project argument.

reader2.note: Workspace of named projects attached in one SQLite db, queries take project= selector.

reader1.note: files.content_hash/mtime compared on reindex so unchanged files are skipped.

reader2.note: Per-file content hash compared before re-parsing; unchanged files skipped.

reader1.note: Watching is via git hooks (post-commit, post-checkout) that reindex; no filesystem watcher.

reader2.note: Git post-commit and post-checkout hooks trigger reindex (no filesystem watcher process).

reader1.note: Uses git ls-files (honours .gitignore), default ignore patterns and max file size limits.

reader2.note: Uses git ls-files (gitignore aware), default ignore globs, max_file_size and language limits.

reader1.note: Query commands can print JSON (search --json-output, tool <name>), but there is no command that exports the graph itself.

reader2.note: Query results can be printed as JSON (search -j, tool command); no command that dumps the graph or index to a file format.

reader1.searched: grep in src/srclight/*.py and extractors/: mermaid, digraph, graphviz, .dot, svg, export in cli.py, server.py, web.py, community.py
reader1.note: The web dashboard shows stats and search; nothing emits DOT, Mermaid or SVG of graph nodes and edges.

reader2.searched: grep -rn -i 'mermaid|graphviz|digraph|\.dot|svg|cytoscape|d3' in src/srclight/*.py (only vector dot-product hits); web.py routes
reader2.note: Dashboard shows tables and status; nothing emits a graph diagram.

reader1.note: get_impact/get_dependents walk call edges backwards (optionally transitive) to affected symbols.

reader2.note: get_impact walks callers transitively to a blast radius with risk.

reader1.note: Parses git diff hunks, maps them to overlapping symbols and runs impact analysis on each.

reader2.note: Maps git diff hunks to indexed symbols then runs compute_impact on each.

reader1.note: Symbols with no inbound edges are listed; no import-cycle detection exists (grep cycle/circular found none).

reader2.note: Lists symbols with no inbound edges, excluding entry points, tests and vendored paths; no cycle report.

reader1.note: Per-file churn (git hotspots) and per-file symbol counts are computed and reported; no cyclomatic complexity.

reader2.note: Per-file churn from git log and per-file symbol-count hotspots; line_count per symbol; no cyclomatic complexity.

reader1.searched: grep in src/srclight/*.py and extractors/: context, bundle, budget, max_tokens, get_context in server.py, db.py; get_symbol/get_callers/get_impact handlers
reader1.note: Tools return one facet each (get_symbol source only, callers and impact separately); no single call assembles code, relations and docs under a size/token budget (token fields only record learnings).

reader2.searched: grep -rn -i 'token_budget|max_tokens|budget|context_bundle|get_context' in src/srclight/server.py, tool_dispatch.py, cli.py; get_symbol and codebase_map read
reader2.note: No tool assembles code, callers and docs under a size bound; get_symbol returns one symbol's source only.
